To measure LFP similarity—that is, the similarity between predicted and ground-truth legal facts—we employ three metrics: (1) ROUGE; (2) ChatLaw-based similarity, which calculates the distance between the predicted and ground-truth facts based on their embeddings determined by the ChatLaw-Text2Vecw model; and (3) LLM-Judge scores assigned by GPT-4o on a ten-point scale.
